caption.en: A developer follows up on a dependency with another team.
caption.zh: 开发者跟进另一个团队提供的依赖。

description.en: A developer follows up on a dependency with another team.
description.zh: 开发者跟进另一个团队提供的依赖。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Is the API dependency ready for integration?
dialogue.zh: 这个 API 依赖已经可以用于集成了吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Not yet. The other team is finishing its tests.
dialogue.zh: 还没。他们团队正在完成测试。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll follow up by phone and ask for an updated estimate.
dialogue.zh: 我会打电话跟进，询问最新的预计时间。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thanks. Please tell them which part is blocking us.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。请告诉他们是哪一部分阻塞了我们。

communication_goal: 跟进跨团队依赖并说明阻塞点。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: One coworker holds a physical phone to their ear while standing next to a seated teammate. Phone is a simple recognizable handset with a visible outline, away from face enough to locate. Small office desk.

coverage_review.scope: W028 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：左侧人物手持电话听筒。 前三词由对白提供语境证据，静态画面不能单独证明，不设局部框。 真实裁剪发现切边后按1254尺寸修正并增加6/1000边缘余量。
